{"script": "#!/bin/bash

# Create a FreeCAD document with a sketch containing a circle of radius 10mm in XY plane
python3 << 'EOF'
import FreeCAD
import Part
import Sketcher

# Create a new document
doc = FreeCAD.newDocument("Sketch")

# Create a sketch object
sketch = doc.addObject("Sketcher::SketchObject", "CircleSketch")

# Map the sketch to the XY plane (Plane is XY_Plane which is typically index 0 or mapped to XY)
sketch.MapMode = "FlatFace"
sketch.Placement = FreeCAD.Placement(FreeCAD.Vector(0, 0, 0), FreeCAD.Rotation(FreeCAD.Vector(0, 0, 1), 0))

# Add a circle with radius 10mm
# The circle will be centered at origin by default
sketch.addGeometry(Part.Circle(FreeCAD.Vector(0, 0, 0), FreeCAD.Vector(0, 0, 1), 10), False)

# Constrain the circle center to origin
geo_idx = 0
sketch.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("InternalAlignment:PointOnPoint", geo_idx, 1, 0, 0))

# Save the document
doc.saveAs("/home/user/Unnamed.FCStd")

# Recompute to ensure everything is valid
doc.recompute()

print("Document saved successfully to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd")
print(f"Sketch has {len(sketch.Geometry)} geometry elements")

EOF
"}

import FreeCAD
import Part
import Sketcher

# Create a new document
doc = FreeCAD.newDocument("Sketch")

# Create a sketch object mapped to XY plane
sketch = doc.addObject("Sketcher::SketchObject", "CircleSketch")

# Set the sketch to be on XY plane
sketch.Support = [(doc.Object, ['Face1'])] if hasattr(doc, 'Object') else []

# Add a circle with radius 10mm centered at origin
circle_geo = Part.Circle(FreeCAD.Vector(0, 0, 0), FreeCAD.Vector(0, 0, 1), 10)
sketch.addGeometry(circle_geo, False)

# Add constraint to fix center at origin (PointOnPoint constraint with virtual origin)
sketch.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('PointOnPoint', 0, -1))

# Save the document
doc.saveAs("/home/user/Unnamed.FCStd")
doc.recompute()

print("Done")
EOF
